===
Component type with members
===
type component C {
  port P p1, p2;
  timer t := 1.0;
  var integer v := 0;
  const charstring c := "x";
  var template integer vt := ?;
  port P parr[3];
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (ComponentTypeDecl TypeTok: "type" CompTok: "component"
      Name: (Ident "C")
      Body: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "port"
            Type: (Ident "P")
            Decls: (Declarator
              Name: (Ident "p1"))
            Decls: (Declarator
              Name: (Ident "p2"))))
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl
            Type: (Ident "timer")
            Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
              Name: (Ident "t")
              Value: (ValueLiteral "1.0"))))
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "var"
            Type: (Ident "integer")
            Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
              Name: (Ident "v")
              Value: (ValueLiteral "0"))))
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "const"
            Type: (Ident "charstring")
            Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
              Name: (Ident "c")
              Value: (ValueLiteral "\"x\""))))
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "var"
            TemplateRestriction: (RestrictionSpec TemplateTok: "template")
            Type: (Ident "integer")
            Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
              Name: (Ident "vt")
              Value: (ValueLiteral "?"))))
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "port"
            Type: (Ident "P")
            Decls: (Declarator
              Name: (Ident "parr")
